card.label: Card
card.description: A single card. Swap it into your deck

removal.label: Purge
removal.description: Permanently remove a card from your deck. Purge price climbs each time

stickers.label: +1 Rank
stickers.description: +1 card rank (stops at Ace)

stickers.label: −1 Rank
stickers.description: -1 card rank (stops at 2)

stickers.label: +2 Rank
stickers.description: +2 card rank (stops at Ace)

stickers.label: −2 Rank
stickers.description: -2 card rank (stops at 2)

stickers.label: Random Rank
stickers.description: Change to random rank

stickers.label: Random Suit
stickers.description: Change to random suit

stickers.label: Change to ♠
stickers.description: Change suit to ♠

stickers.label: Change to ♥
stickers.description: Change suit to ♥

stickers.label: Change to ♦
stickers.description: Change suit to ♦

stickers.label: Change to ♣
stickers.description: Change suit to ♣

stickers.label: Same-Safe
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this rank → Safe
If no pile's top card matches this rank → Sticker becomes cursed

stickers.label: Guard
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → this card is safe when it lands.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

stickers.label: Heart Guard
stickers.description: Safe if this card lands on a ♥, or a ♥ lands on this card

stickers.label: Diamond Guard
stickers.description: Safe if this card lands on a ♦, or a ♦ lands on this card

stickers.label: Club Guard
stickers.description: Safe if this card lands on a ♣, or a ♣ lands on this card

stickers.label: Payout
stickers.description:
At deal end if this card tops its pile → earn coins equal to pile size.
Any card played on top of this card is cursed

stickers.label: Bonus Coin
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → +1 coin per pile whose top card matches.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

stickers.label: Anchor
stickers.description:
At deal end if this card tops its pile → exclude the pile from the smallest-pile score.
Any card played on top of this card is cursed

stickers.label: Last Coin
stickers.description: +3 coins if it kills a pile

stickers.label: Heavy
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → +1 pile size to every pile whose top matches, including this one.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

stickers.label: Massive
stickers.description: +2 pile size

stickers.label: Collector
stickers.description: +1 coin per other sticker on this card

stickers.label: Compound
stickers.description: +X coins. X starts at 0, grows by 1 each correct placement, resets to 0 on a wrong guess

stickers.label: Scout
stickers.description: Peek at the next deck card

stickers.label: Wild Suit
stickers.description: Counts as every suit

stickers.label: Shuffle
stickers.description: Optionally shuffle the pile

stickers.label: Donate
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → make all pile sizes equal.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

stickers.label: Quick Bury
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → bury 1 card under this pile.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

stickers.label: Twin Spark
stickers.description: Peek at the next card if another pile's top card matches this rank

stickers.label: Loose Change
stickers.description: +0–3 coins (random)

stickers.label: Snowball Bury
stickers.description: Bury X cards. X starts at 0, grows by 1 each correct placement, resets to 0 on a wrong guess

stickers.label: Deep Pockets
stickers.description: +1 coin per 10 cards left in the deck

stickers.label: Pillar Scout
stickers.description:
If this column has no Pillar → peek at the next card.
If it has one → this sticker becomes a curse

stickers.label: Base Scout
stickers.description:
If this column has no Base → peek at the next card.
If it has one → this sticker becomes a curse

stickers.label: Spade Snob
stickers.description: When a ♠ lands on this card, or this card lands on a ♠ → peek at the next card

stickers.label: Heart Snob
stickers.description: When a ♥ lands on this card, or this card lands on a ♥ → +2 coins

stickers.label: Ripple
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → optionally shuffle those piles.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

stickers.label: Club Snob
stickers.description: When a ♣ lands on this card, or this card lands on a ♣ → bury 1 deck card under the pile

stickers.label: Heart Choir
stickers.description: +1 coin per each pile with a ♥ top card

stickers.label: Diamond Ripple
stickers.description: Shuffle every other pile with a ♦ top card

stickers.label: Rank Roots
stickers.description: When this card lands → bury 1 card under each pile whose top card matches this card's rank

stickers.label: Spade Whispers
stickers.description: The next X cards show a hint (higher/lower/same), where X = other piles with a ♠ top card

stickers.label: Tell
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → this card shows a tell (higher, lower, or same) for the next draw.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

stickers.label: Recharge Shield
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this rank → Charge Same Shield
If no pile's top card matches this rank → Sticker becomes cursed

stickers.label: Tap Power
stickers.description:
If another pile's top card matches this rank → Fire Same Power
If no pile's top card matches this rank → Sticker becomes cursed

stickers.label: Leech
stickers.description: Cursed. −3 coins

stickers.label: Shrink
stickers.description: Cursed. This card counts −1 toward pile size

stickers.label: Mute
stickers.description: Cursed. While this is a pile's top card, Same cannot be called there

stickers.label: Trapdoor
stickers.description: Cursed. When it lands, the card at the BOTTOM of the pile returns to the deck

stickers.label: Spoiler
stickers.description: Cursed. Reset bonus coins earned this deal to 0

stickers.label: Shield Drain
stickers.description: Cursed. Drain the Same Shield

stickers.label: Flatline
stickers.description: Cursed. While this card is a pile's top card, that pile size is 1

stickers.label: Magnet
stickers.description: Cursed. While this is a pile's top card, your next guess must be played there

stickers.label: Jammer
stickers.description: Cursed. While this is a pile's top card, the column's Pillar does not work

stickers.label: Peeler
stickers.description: Cursed. Any card that lands on this card loses its stickers

stickers.label: Base Drain
stickers.description: Cursed. The column's Base is drained

stickers.label: Malfunction
stickers.description: Cursed. 10% chance this card kills the pile anyway, even if the guess is correct

stickers.label: Saboteur
stickers.description: Cursed. 10% chance the column's Base or Pillar is destroyed

pillars.label: Heart Bonus
pillars.description: When a ♥ lands in this column → +1 coin

pillars.label: Column Tie-Safe
pillars.description: Any tie is safe in this column

pillars.label: Last Licks
pillars.description: At deal end → +3 coins if no pile in this column survived

pillars.label: Guardian
pillars.description: At deal end → +4 coins if every pile in this column survived

pillars.label: Clean Bury
pillars.description: When a ♣ with no stickers lands in this column → bury 1 card under that pile

pillars.label: All Hearts
pillars.description: At deal end → +4 coins if every surviving pile in this column has a ♥ top card

pillars.label: Envy
pillars.description: At deal end → +2 coins per pile in this column with a ♥ top card

pillars.label: Streak Size
pillars.description: From the 3rd consecutive correct guess in this column → +1 pile size per guess. Resets on a wrong guess or any guess in another column

pillars.label: Streak Bury
pillars.description: From the 4th consecutive correct guess in this column → bury 1 card per guess. Resets on a wrong guess or any guess in another column

pillars.label: Fourth Seat
pillars.description: This column starts the deal with 1 extra pile (up to 4)

pillars.label: Second Wind
pillars.description: Each pile that dies in this column has a 25% chance to be saved, but all the buried cards return to the deck

pillars.label: Greedy
pillars.description: At deal end → +4 coins if this is the only equipped pillar

pillars.label: Highest Heart
pillars.description: At deal end → earn coins equal to the highest numbered ♥ top card in this column (2–10 face value, Ace pays 1, royals pay 0)

pillars.label: Dense Bury
pillars.description: When a ♣ with 3+ stickers lands correctly in this column → bury 1 card under that pile

pillars.label: Revive
pillars.description: When a pile in this column reaches 10 cards → revive one dead pile

pillars.label: Bulk Rate
pillars.description: The store's Purge price climbs by 1 instead of 2. No effect during deal

pillars.label: Freebie
pillars.description: One random item in every store costs 0 coins. No effect during deal

pillars.label: Rare Hunter
pillars.description: Rare items appear in the store twice as often. No effect during deal

pillars.label: Bouncer
pillars.description: 30% chance to turn away a Just a Two mystery. 100% chance if there are no 2s in your deck. No effect during deal

pillars.label: Queen-Finder
pillars.description: +30% chance to find a Beheaded Queen at a mystery stop. 100% chance if Queens are the most common rank in your deck (ties don't count). No effect during deal

pillars.label: Flypaper
pillars.description: When a card lands correctly in this column → 5% chance it gains a random sticker

pillars.label: Underdog
pillars.description: When a {rank} lands correctly in this column → bury 1 deck card under that pile

pillars.label: Crowd Favorite
pillars.description: When a {rank} lands correctly in this column → +2 coins

pillars.label: Insurance
pillars.description: At deal end → +8 coins if only one pile is alive

pillars.label: Ditto
pillars.description: Mirrors the center column's pillar

pillars.label: Massive Diamond
pillars.description: ♦ cards in this column count as +2 toward pile size

pillars.label: Prime
pillars.description: When a prime-rank card (2/3/5/7) lands correctly in this column → +1 coin

pillars.label: Queen's Eye
pillars.description: When a royal ♠ (J/Q/K) lands in this column → peek at the next card

pillars.label: Shuffler
pillars.description: When a ♦ lands in this column → optionally shuffle the other piles in this column

pillars.label: Excavator
pillars.description: At deal end → +1 coin per buried card in this column's largest pile with a ♥ top card

pillars.label: Gambler
pillars.description: At deal end → 50/50: +3 coins or nothing

pillars.label: Last Rites
pillars.description: When a pile in this column dies → peek the next card

pillars.label: Static
pillars.description: When a ♠ lands in this column → 50% chance to peek at the next card

pillars.label: Wild Aces
pillars.description: Aces count as high or low in this column

pillars.label: Diamond Anchor
pillars.description: At deal end → exclude any pile in this column with a ♦ top card from the smallest-pile score

pillars.label: Diamond Distribution
pillars.description: When a ♦ lands in this column → make all piles in this column equal size

pillars.label: Empty Ranks Bury
pillars.description: When a ♣ lands in this column → bury 1 card under that pile per rank with zero copies in your full deck

pillars.label: Empty Ranks Coins
pillars.description: When a ♥ lands in this column → +2 coins per rank with zero copies in your full deck

pillars.label: Empty Ranks Heavy
pillars.description: When a ♦ lands in this column → +1 pile size per rank with zero copies in your full deck

pillars.label: Crazy Eights
pillars.description: If 8s are the most common rank in your full deck → this column's piles start at pile size 8

pillars.label: Royal Sanctuary
pillars.description: If your full deck contains no 2s → royals (J/Q/K) are always safe in this column

pillars.label: Void Tribute
pillars.description: If your full deck contains no {suit} → when a ♣ lands in this column, bury 2 cards under that pile

pillars.label: Majority Rule
pillars.description: If half or more of your full deck is {suit} → {suit} cards are safe when they land in this column

pillars.label: Diamond Echo
pillars.description: When a ♦ lands in this column → +1 pile size per duplicate of that card's rank in your full deck

pillars.label: Curse Ward
pillars.description: Stickers that would convert into curses in this column don't — they stay as stickers

pillars.label: Final Cut
pillars.description: Permanently purge whichever card kills the final pile in this column

pillars.label: Close Call
pillars.description: Same calls are safe on cards ±1 in value in this column. A survived Same counts as a full correct Same — charges the Same Shield and fires your Same-Power

pillars.label: Royal Pair
pillars.description: A royal landing on a royal survives a Same call in this column. A survived Same counts as a full correct Same — charges the Same Shield and fires your Same-Power

pillars.label: Perfect Ten
pillars.description: Ranks summing to 10 survive a Same call in this column. A survived Same counts as a full correct Same — charges the Same Shield and fires your Same-Power

pillars.label: Same Suit Safe
pillars.description: A card landing on its own suit is safe in this column

pillars.label: Rank Shield
pillars.description: Most common card in deck ({rank}) is always safe in this column

pillars.label: Scarce Suit
pillars.description: The suit your deck holds the fewest of is safe when it lands in this column

pillars.label: Flat Purge
pillars.description: On purchase → the store's Purge price is halved (minimum 5). No effect during deal

pillars.label: On the House
pillars.description: The first restock in each store and the first reshuffle of each deal are free

pillars.label: Eight Ball
pillars.description: When an 8 lands in this column → peek at the next card

pillars.label: Pauper's Heart
pillars.description: While your purse holds under 10 coins → when a ♥ lands in this column, peek 1 card

pillars.label: Pauper's Diamond
pillars.description: While your purse holds under 10 coins → a ♦ landing anywhere on the board counts +2 toward pile size instead of +1

pillars.label: Pauper's Spade
pillars.description: While your purse holds under 10 coins → when a ♠ lands in this column, the next card shows a tell (higher/lower/same)

pillars.label: Pauper's Club
pillars.description: While your purse holds under 10 coins → when a ♣ lands in this column, bury 1 card under that pile

pillars.label: Curse Harvest
pillars.description: When a cursed card lands in this column → bury 1 card under that pile, then peek at the next card

pillars.label: Club Thin
pillars.description: When a ♣ lands in this column → bury 1 card per 25 cards remaining in the deck

pillars.label: Rank Purge
pillars.description: On purchase → purge every {rank} from your deck. No effect during deal

pillars.label: Diamond Lifeline
pillars.description: While any pile in this column has pile size 1 → a ♦ landing anywhere on the board counts +2 toward pile size instead of +1

bases.label: Kamikaze
bases.description: Kill a random ♠-topped pile in this column, → peek the next 2 cards

bases.label: Spade Peeker
bases.description: Peek the next card. Requires every pile in this column has a ♠ on top

bases.label: Upheaval
bases.description: Shuffle every pile in this column

bases.label: Phoenix
bases.description: Revive a random dead pile in this column. Buried cards return to the deck

bases.label: Wild Sticker
bases.description: Apply a random sticker to a random top card in this column

bases.label: Ballast
bases.description: Make ALL piles on the board equal size

bases.label: Rank Setter
bases.description: Permanently set every top card's rank in this column to the bottom pile's rank

bases.label: Suit Setter
bases.description: Permanently set every top card's suit in this column to the bottom pile's suit

bases.label: Sticker Harvest
bases.description: Choose a pile → bury 2 cards per sticker on its top card, then peel all those stickers

bases.label: Reactor
bases.description: Recharge your other two bases

bases.label: Club Dig
bases.description: Bury 1 card under each ♣-topped pile in this column

bases.label: Demolish
bases.description: Destroy this column's pillar permanently, then peek the next 3 cards

bases.label: Heart Demolish
bases.description: Destroy every ♥-topped pile in this column. +4 coins per pile destroyed

bases.label: Heart Tax
bases.description: +1 coin per ♥ card in this column

bases.label: Recharge Cell
bases.description: Charge the Same Shield

bases.label: Power Surge
bases.description: Activate your Same-Power

bases.label: Last Resort
bases.description: In a non-boss deal, bury the whole deck under a pile in this column and win instantly. Any Base nearby is destroyed

bases.label: Empty Purse
bases.description: Spend ALL your coins → peek 1 card, +1 more per 10 coins spent

bases.label: Same Tell
bases.description: If the next card is the SAME rank as a top card anywhere on the board, the = mark appears on that card

bases.label: Lone Eye
bases.description: Peek the next card. Only works while no Same-Power is equipped

bases.label: Club Oracle
bases.description: Put a tell marker on each ♣-topped pile in this column for the next draw. Tell marker shows if the next card is higher, lower, or same

bases.label: Escape Hatch
bases.description: Only usable in an ambush from Just a Two → clear the deal instantly

bases.label: Purge Coupon
bases.description: Reduce the Store's Purge cost by 2 ({current} → {new}). Minimum 5

bases.label: Bonus Reset
bases.description: Reset bonus coins earned this deal to zero, then peek the next card

bases.label: Transmute
bases.description: Change all {rank}s to {suit}

bases.label: Sacrifice
bases.description: Choose a pile → purge its top card from your deck, then kill that pile

bases.label: Devil's Deal
bases.description: Double your bonus coins earned this deal, then add a curse to a top card in this column

bases.label: Cleanse
bases.description: Remove all curses from the top cards in this column

bases.label: Chorus
bases.description: Set every top card in this column to {rank}

bases.label: Diamond Boost
bases.description: Every pile with a ♦ top card in this column → +3 pile size

samePowers.label: Burrow
samePowers.description: Bury 1 card under every pile with a {suit} top card

samePowers.label: Dividend
samePowers.description: Gain 1 coin for each alive pile

samePowers.label: Cleanse All
samePowers.description: When you call a correct Same → clear all curses from every top card on the board

samePowers.label: Second Sight
samePowers.description: Every alive pile shows a tell (higher/lower/same) for the next draw

samePowers.label: Sticker Spray
samePowers.description: Apply a random sticker to every top card in this column

samePowers.label: Long Odds
samePowers.description: 50% chance to purge a card from the deck

samePowers.label: Same Heavy
samePowers.description: Add +1 pile size to every pile, and +3 to the pile you called Same on

samePowers.label: Rank Flood
samePowers.description: A correct Same sets the top card of every alive pile to this card's rank. A Joker on either side ranks them by the ranked card; Joker-on-Joker makes Aces

packs.label: Large Card Pack
packs.description: Reveals 5 random cards. Keep 2 to swap into your deck

packs.label: Small Card Pack
packs.description: Reveals 3 random cards. Keep 1 to swap into your deck
